title: Structures, Hydraulics and Pneumatics
src: Practice questions written for Glidepath from the Aviator's Handbook, Part 3, 3-3 to 3-8 (not printed in the book: the Handbook has no question bank)

qs.q: Strain is:
o: Change in size ÷ original size, with no unit

qs.q: Proof load equals the design limit load multiplied by:
qs.ex: No permanent deformation at proof load.

qs.q: Design ultimate load equals the design limit load multiplied by:
qs.ex: May deform but must not collapse.

qs.q: A fail-safe structure relies on:
o: Redundant load paths and periodic inspection

qs.q: A safe-life component is:
o: Inspected and kept until it cracks
Duplicated by a second load path
